description: Committed staged changes covering title system, panel swap refactor, left sidebar sections, settings persistence expansion, render order fixes, and extensive test updates.
commit_message: CollageMaker: add title system (handlers, interaction, manager), refactor hex panel swap to general panel swap, add left sidebar sections, expand settings persistence for 7 new title fields; fix render order and add extensive tests
work_performed: Inspected git status, staged diff (--cached), and recent commit log
Committed all staged CollageMaker project files (43 files)
Verified no secrets or unrelated files were included in the commit

major_changes: Title system: createTitleHandlers, TitleInteraction (drag to move, edge-drag resize), TitleManager (set/get position and width)
Panel swap refactor: HexPanelSwap → PanelSwap (generalizes from hex-specific to all panel types)
Left sidebar sections: layout + library moved from right sidebar
Settings persistence: 7 new title fields (titleFontOpacity, titleBgOpacity, titleBoxWidth/X/Y, titleShowBackground, titleBackgroundColor)
Render order fix: drag target drawn before selection border to avoid compositing artifacts
GestureHandler: pointerdown no longer triggers panel selection (swap handler handles via pointerup)
Extensive test updates and new tests across all affected modules

notes: This is a large feature iteration commit (~6200 lines net addition)
Commit follows existing repo style: 'CollageMaker: <summary>' with semicolons
Co-Authored-By line included per project convention
Branch prototype/collage-maker is 1 commit ahead of origin
